# intutic_workspace_budget <Badge type="tip" text="Cloud" />

The workspace's daily and monthly LLM spend caps and budget alert threshold (Settings › Billing › Budget Limits). One per workspace; the OWNER or ADMIN role writes it. Destroying the resource leaves the caps as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "intutic_workspace_budget" "this" {
  daily_budget_usd    = 150
  monthly_budget_usd  = 3000
  alert_threshold_pct = 80
  monthly_enforcement = "hard"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `daily_budget_usd` (Number) Daily cap in USD (0–100,000); 0 is no daily cap. A UTC day.
- `monthly_budget_usd` (Number) Monthly cap in USD (0–1,000,000); 0 is no monthly cap. A UTC calendar month.

### Optional

- `alert_threshold_pct` (Number) Raise a budget alert at this percentage of each cap, and of every key and member budget (1–100).
- `daily_enforcement` (String) `hard`: the proxy refuses a request the rest of the day's cap does not cover, with `429 BUDGET_EXCEEDED`. `soft`: the cap only raises alerts. Defaults to `hard`.
- `monthly_enforcement` (String) `hard`: the proxy refuses a request the rest of the month's cap does not cover, with `429 BUDGET_EXCEEDED`. `soft`: the cap only raises alerts. Defaults to `soft`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace id.

## Import

```shell
# Import by workspace id; there is one budget per workspace.
terraform import intutic_workspace_budget.this ws_0123456789abcdef
```
